name: Preserve America PAC
summary: A single-candidate super PAC for Donald Trump, funded mainly by Sheldon and Miriam Adelson in 2020 and by Miriam Adelson after his death. It spent more than $100 million in each of the 2020 and 2024 elections; in 2024 its ads attacked Kamala Harris in Michigan, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin. Chris LaCivita ran it in 2020; Dave Carney led it in 2024.
